title: Server returns 500 error on POST /api/auth/login after latest deployment
root_cause: The defect originates in app/routes/auth.py at line 42, where bcrypt.checkpw is called with a string instead of bytes for user.password_hash.

changes_made.rationale: bcrypt.checkpw requires both arguments to be bytes; encoding the stored hash converts it from str to bytes, satisfying the API contract and eliminating the TypeError

diff:
--- a/app/routes/auth.py
+++ b/app/routes/auth.py
@@ -49,7 +49,7 @@
     # causing a TypeError: a bytes-like object is required, not 'str'
     is_valid = bcrypt.checkpw(
         payload.password.encode("utf-8"),
-        user.password_hash
+        user.password_hash.encode("utf-8")
     )
 
     if not is_valid:
